Hmm, but wait — the tracks end at capture; moving_now=true with heading south directly at base, ETA 15-20 min. Three trucks converging toward the base. That's attention-worthy. But also consider: are these the same vehicles as livestock trucks in a market? The image is a livestock market area. Livestock trucks D1 (small truck with animals), D2 (big truck loaded with cattle). D1=T0028, D2=T0001 — both loaded livestock trucks heading toward base at ~11-16 km/h. ETA 15-19 min. Multiple trucks converging on base simultaneously — attention required, high priority? Livestock trucks heading toward base at ~12 km/h. Hmm, but they're loaded livestock trucks. Still, three tracks closing on base with ETA ~16-20 min, plus radio contact lost with patrol in Kuzey Yolu zone (frame is 749m from Kuzey Yolu zone).

R064/R076: patrol radio contact lost 40 min in Kuzey Yolu zone — frame nearest zone Kuzey Yolu, 749 m away. That's a concern but relates to zone, not vehicle.

R100: 7 trucks stopped near 39.9453,32.8582 — matches detections (6 trucks conf≥0.3 within 60m, plus D5). Partially consistent — 7 claimed vs we see 6 trucks ≥0.3 + 2 low-conf (D8 false, D7 real) = actually count real trucks: D1,D2,D3,D4,D5,D7 = 6 trucks + D6 car. Report says 7 kamyon durdu — but several are moving, not stopped. Partially consistent.

Let me check reports search maybe not needed. Also D3 (T0068) moving away — no attention. D4 (T0135) closing at 2.2 m/s, ETA 20 min — attention. D6 car T0055 heading east away — no.

- T0068 (D3) üsten uzaklaşıyor (heading kuzey, bearing'e göre 172°), T0055 (D6) doğuya uzaklaşıyor — dikkat gerekmez.
- R100 "7 kamyon durdu" diyor; karede 60 m içinde 6 güvenilir kamyon var ve en az ikisi (D1, D2) hareket halinde — kısmen uyumlu.
